title: FancyZones Override Windows Snap Adds Extra Unintended Hotkeys to Move Windows
summary: The reported Ctrl+Win+Alt+arrow behavior is FancyZones multi-zone expansion rather than an unintended Windows Snap shortcut; the discussion identifies the documented behavior.

judgment.rationale: The discussion explains the observed shortcut as the existing expand-window-to-adjacent-zones feature. The report identifies unexpectedness/discoverability, not evidence that implementation malfunctions. No code change is supported by this thread.
evidence: The reporter says Override Windows Snap is enabled and observes Ctrl+Win+Alt+arrow expanding a window.
A commenter explains the shortcut expands a window across multiple zones and links the FancyZones documentation.
The thread contains no evidence that the documented action misbehaves.
judgment.recommended_action: No fix proposal; leave the documented behavior unchanged.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported action is explained by current FancyZones behavior and documentation; a PowerToys defect or competing code fix is not supported.
